portalsFound.observation: West Bengal land-record portal offers plot information and plot-map requests; an open parcel polygon endpoint was not identified.
State geoportal describes a statewide georeferenced cadastral database project, but does not expose that dataset publicly here.
Geoportal access is for government departments with registration by official letter.

remainingUncertainty: Statewide project scope is not public countrywide coverage; the public plot-map service was unavailable from this client and may use non-vector delivery.
nextStep: Recheck Banglarbhumi and seek a documented public West Bengal feature service, then test a Kolkata-area parcel sample.
